# Current Security contract fixtures

Copied without rewriting from `beacon-observability/beacon-security-spec`
commit `4a30f30e1027568cfbcf8661079a072fc89bd825`.
Schemas, examples, and vectors are Apache-2.0 licensed. Historical fixtures in
the parent directory remain unchanged. SIEM vector paths are relative to this
directory. The current v2 schema validates evidence inside `message`; the SIEM
schema validates the exported Body.
